Team — quick read of the ask and proposed approach. Key redline / negotiation points we should consider before sending to Novum:

1) Exhibit C capacity add: we should phrase this as a timeboxed 'Supplemental Capacity Exhibit' (Oct 1–Dec 31, 2025) with explicit rollback/return-to-baseline clause at pilot end. Avoid open-ended permanent commits.

2) Pricing approach: prefer a time-limited surcharge per-GPU node (flat per-node fee) rather than changing the base Order Form tier; reduces churn post-pilot. Karthik to run pricing model and give suggested per-node fee (estimate due 1pm PT).

3) SOW Operational Readiness: agree to add this as Exhibit H with deliverables and acceptance criteria. We should include a limitation of liability carve for onboarding tasks (standard language) and a clause that metrics for acceptance are mutually agreed within 5 business days of signature.

4) Data handling: Novum noted monitoring runbook — ensure we ask for confirmation in writing that logs/metrics will not include PII; if they request PII access we need an escalation path and a DPA update.

5) DocuSign flow: propose a two-step signature (Order Form + Exhibit H) to avoid re-executing the entire MSA. If Novum insists on MSA amendment we'll need exec legal sign-off.

I've attached a short redline summary and a proposed Exhibit H template for Stephanie to send externally. If Karthik can provide pricing by 1pm PT, I can incorporate both and aim to get back to Emma same day.

-Markus
